description.value: Burger Crush is a BC-born fast-casual chain reviving the classic burger shop with smashed Canadian Angus beef burgers, vegan and veggie alternatives, hand-dipped shakes, and loaded fries. This Colwood location sits on Sooke Road, positioning it as a convenient refueling stop for cyclists heading out toward the West Shore and beyond. The menu skews inclusive, with house-made vegan patties, tofu nuggets, and dairy-free shakes alongside the beef options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Burger Crush is a real, operating three-location burger chain with active online ordering. The OSM phone number (250-590-3919) and addr:unit (116) both match the Colwood location listed on the website's contact page as '116-1901 Sooke Rd, Colwood, BC' — not the downtown Victoria location at 787 Fort St.; the coordinates (48.4415, -123.4696) also place this in the Colwood/West Shore area, confirming the OSM community tag 'Victoria' is a loose regional label. The website confirms pickup/delivery ordering and an extensive vegan/vegetarian menu, but makes no mention of cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or wi-fi.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Victoria' but the phone number, addr:unit (116), and coordinates (48.4415, -123.4696) all match the Colwood location at 116-1901 Sooke Rd, Colwood, BC — not the Victoria location at 787 Fort St. with phone (250) 882-4598. The record should be attributed to Colwood, not Victoria.
OSM address field is blank; full address derived from the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating burger restaurant with confirmed web presence and active ordering; a practical food stop for cyclists on the Sooke Road corridor in Colwood.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Vegan Cheeseburger (vegan bun, crush-made vegan patty, vegan cheese), 'Veggie Style' Cheeseburger (crush-made vegan patty with dairy cheese), Vegan Nuggets (house-made tofu), vegan dips, and Vegan Shakes made with Nora's cashew & coconut milk ice cream
